response.answer: EU funds have shown varied impacts on total factor productivity (TFP) growth over time, with recent studies highlighting the role of innovation and digital economy in enhancing productivity. Policy relevance and data-driven analysis indicate significant regional heterogeneity in economic growth and job creation. Recent trends emphasize the importance of intangible assets and R&I in productivity growth.
